name: alchemy-likec4
description: Generate a LikeC4 specification from alchemy's resource registry

scripts.example:generate: bun run example:basic && bun run example:shortener && bun run example:monorepo
scripts.example:basic: bun run src/cli.ts generate --project examples/basic/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/basic/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod
scripts.example:shortener: bun run src/cli.ts generate --project examples/link-shortener/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/link-shortener/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod && bun run src/cli.ts generate --project examples/link-shortener/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/link-shortener/alchemy.run.ts --stage staging
scripts.example:png: likec4 export png examples/link-shortener/docs/architecture --flat -f index -o . && mv index.png shortener.png && likec4 export png examples/basic/docs/architecture --flat -f my_app_prod -o . && mv my_app_prod.png screenshot.png && likec4 export png examples/monorepo/docs/architecture --flat -f landscape -o . && mv landscape.png monorepo.png
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build && bun run example:generate && bun run example:validate && bun test
scripts.example:monorepo: bun run src/cli.ts generate --project examples/monorepo/docs/architecture --entrypoint examples/basic/alchemy.run.ts --entrypoint examples/link-shortener/alchemy.run.ts --stage prod
